name: OpenProject Meetings
description: OpenProject Meetings API (list/create/update/…). Für neue Besprechungen: operation=create mit title, startTime (ISO-8601), duration (z.B. PT1H), project_id.
author: ki-basis

filters.description: JSON filters (OpenProject queries format). Valid fields include project. (operations: list)

pageSize.description: Number of elements per page (operations: list)

title.description: The agenda item's title. (operations: create_agenda_item, update_agenda_item, create_section, update_section, create, update)

notes.description: {format: string, raw: string, html: string} (operations: create_agenda_item, update_agenda_item, create_outcome, update_outcome)

durationInMinutes.description: The agenda item's duration in minutes. — integer (numeric string ok) (operations: create_agenda_item, update_agenda_item)

itemType.description: The type of this agenda item (simple or work_package). — enum: simple|work_package (operations: create_agenda_item, update_agenda_item)

lockVersion.description: The version of the item as used for optimistic locking. Required for PATCH operations. — integer (numeric string ok) (operations: create_agenda_item, update_agenda_item, create, update)

id.description: Agenda item identifier — integer (numeric string ok) (operations: delete_agenda_item, get_agenda_item, update_agenda_item, delete_outcome, get_outcome, update_outcome, delete_section, get_section, update_section, delete, get, update, list_agenda_items, update_form, list_sections, get_outcome_by_agenda_item, get_agenda_item_by, get_section_by)

kind.description:
The type of this outcome. Possible values:

- *information*: an informational outcome with notes
- *work_package*: an outcome linked to a work package — enum: information|work_package (operations: create_outcome, update_outcome)

startTime.description: The scheduled meeting start time. (operations: create, update)

duration.description: The meeting duration as an ISO 8601 duration (e.g. `PT1H` for 1 hour, `PT1H30M` for 1.5 hours). (operations: create, update)

state.description:
The current state of the meeting. Possible values:

- *open*
- *draft*
- *in_progress*
- *cancelled*
- *closed* — enum: open|draft|in_progress|cancelled|closed (operations: create, update)

sharing.description: How the meeting template is shared. Only applicable for one-time templates. — enum: none|descendants|system (operations: create, update)

template.description: Whether this meeting is a template. (operations: create, update)

notify.description: Whether to send email notifications to participants. (operations: create, update)

meeting_id.description: Meeting identifier — integer (numeric string ok) (operations: list_outcomes, get_outcome_by_agenda_item, get_agenda_item_by, get_section_by)

agenda_item_id.description: Agenda item identifier — integer (numeric string ok) (operations: list_outcomes, get_outcome_by_agenda_item)

project_id.description: Projekt-ID oder Identifier (operations: create, update) — wird als _links.project gesetzt

participant_ids.description: Optionale User-IDs komma-separiert (operations: create) — Versuch über _links.participants

confirmed.description: Optional. Two-Phase write confirm: set confirmed=true (or ja/yes/1) to execute POST/PATCH/PUT/DELETE. Without it, mutating calls return a confirmation ask.
